The biological machinery responsible for this process has been known for some time, but exactly how it works is still contested. In this paper, we describe how a new, high-precision method for measuring protein transport, combined with careful data analysis, can be used to solve this problem. We find that our transport data are best described by a ratchet-type mechanism, in which the protein can diffuse one way but not the other, rather than by physical pushing of the
